name: Woori Financial Group Inc.

ads_ratio.source: Woori Financial Group's own SEC filings (CIK 1264136): Form 20-F filer whose ADS registration statement on Form F-6 states 'American Depositary Shares (ADSs), each ADS representing three (3) Shares of Common Stock, par value 5,000 Won per share'; the NYSE security name itself is 'American Depositary Shares (each representing three (3) shares of Common Stock)'.
ads_ratio.reason: Engine per-share figures are per ordinary share while the traded NYSE price ($70.07) is per ADS; without the ratio every per-share comparison is understated 3x.

fx_conversion.source: frankfurter.app — ECB reference rates (closest business day to each period end)

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 21 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2022, 2023, 2024 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

FX_CONVERTED: reporting currency KRW converted to USD at period-end ECB reference rates (frankfurter.app) — flow facts use the period-end rate, not a period average; the rates used are recorded in dcf_numbers.json fx_conversion
USD_TRANSLATIONS_USED: the issuer files its own USD convenience translations alongside its reporting currency; the engine used the filed USD figures

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 20-F filer — per-share figures scaled x3.0 ordinary shares per ADS (Woori Financial Group's own SEC filings (CIK 1264136): Form 20-F filer whose ADS registration statement on Form F-6 states 'American Depositary Shares (ADSs), each ADS representing three (3) Shares of Common Stock, par value 5,000 Won per share'; the NYSE security name itself is 'American Depositary Shares (each representing three (3) shares of Common Stock)'.) so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Finance sector — OE/capex DCF fits finance names poorly; grade confidence low
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share -17.44 vs 3-yr median 4.46 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
